title: Seller's Property Disclosure (SPD19R)
description: Colorado requires sellers of residential property to complete the CBS-approved Seller's Property Disclosure (SPD19R). Seller must disclose all known material facts.

title: Oil and Gas / Mineral Rights Disclosure
description: Colorado's split estate law requires disclosure when the surface estate is severed from mineral rights. Buyer must be informed whether mineral rights are included.

required_actions.note: Colorado Split Estate Act requires disclosure of mineral development within 1 mile.

title: Methamphetamine Lab Disclosure
description: Colorado requires disclosure if property was used as a methamphetamine lab and has not been properly remediated per CDPHE standards.

required_actions.note: Disclosed on CO-SPD19R under Environmental Conditions.
Unremediated property may not be sold or occupied until CDPHE standards are met.
